comment: The scale output is polyphonic on purpose: channel one carries the scale number, channel two the period in volts and the channels after that the degrees as offsets from the root (scale-bus.hpp), so a scale that no single number can name travels whole. A module that reads only the first channel keeps working unchanged. Every step of every pattern is edited on the display, which holds no parameters and so cannot be reached by clicking for help.
